HOOLHEYAKMOD-FALSE_DOME_EVENT.title: False Dome
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FALSE_DOME_EVENT.pages.INIT:
You finally climbed to the heights of the [gold]Spire[/gold] . Looking up, the ceiling is inlaid with countless shimmering, bizarre ores. They are arranged according to some precise mathematical law, masquerading as a brilliant starry sky in this endless darkness.

You pause. This false dome reminds you of an old acquaintance, a mad pioneer, and that spaceship that broke through the barriers of [gold]Terra[/gold] .
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FALSE_DOME_EVENT.pages.ANAL: You record the orbital laws of these forged stars in your mind; they confirm some of your previous hypotheses.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FALSE_DOME_EVENT.pages.CHAS: The past is not worth mentioning, and the present likewise leads to the future.
